chapters.title: Chapter 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 1 Three days before our engagement party, I saw a new Labubu charm hanging from the rearview mirror in Ethan Cole's car. I asked him where it came from. Ethan didn't even look at me. "A friend gave it to me. It's just a little trinket. Stop being so suspicious." I said nothing else. That night, I came across a private alt account belonging to Lily Hart, my assistant. The post read: I finally managed to get a limited-edition Labubu charm for my boyfriend. I waited in line for three hours, my hands frozen red, but he said he loved it. It's already hanging in his car now.

The photo showed the same Labubu charm with the pink strap. I opened her profile. It was filled with posts about her relationship. I scrolled through them one by one. Then, in a restaurant photo she posted, I saw the rosary bracelet on a man's wrist. It was the blessed rosary bracelet I had gotten for Ethan at a chapel last year. There was only one like it in the world. He had said he would wear it forever. He had kept that promise. He just wore it to see another woman. That night, I messaged the wedding planning company. Hannah: Keep the engagement party schedule as planned.

Hannah: But I want to replace the opening video. I didn't know why Ethan cheated. I only knew that anyone who betrayed love and commitment had to pay a painful price. The next day, I went to the hotel as scheduled to go over the engagement party plans. We had agreed to meet at 2:00 p.m. I arrived 10 minutes early, but Ethan still didn't show up. I called him. He didn't answer the first time. He picked up the second time. There was noise in the 00 TUE 1 R ||| 1/3 O r background. Nasked, "Where are you?" He sounded rushed. "Almost there." "How long is almost?" "Hannah, I said I'm almost there.

Do you really have to press me right now?" I froze. He had never spoken to me like that before. Even if he was only going to be five minutes late, he used to text me ahead of time and explain why. When he arrived, he would apologize properly. An hour later, Ethan finally arrived. He pushed the door open, and a girl followed him in. It was Lily, my assistant. I was the one who had hired her six months earlier. Her resume had been unremarkable, but during the interview, her eyes reddened as she told me her family had always put her brother first.

She said finishing college had already been hard enough, and she really needed the job. I felt sorry for her, so I kept her on as my assistant. She worked hard. She arrived early, left late, prepared my documents before meetings, and even reminded me softly to eat when work ran through mealtimes. During that time, I had spoken highly of her to Ethan. At the time, Ethan only warned me, "Don't be so nice to everyone. People will take you for a fool." Now, it seemed they really had both taken me for a fool. Lily wore a pale pink coat and held a file folder in her arms.

Her cheeks were faintly flushed. The moment she saw me, she lowered her head. "Ms. Pierce, I'm sorry. This is all my fault." I didn't look at her. Instead, I looked calmly at Ethan. "Why is she here?" Ethan tossed his car keys onto the table. "Didn't you say the schedule materials were at the office? I picked her up on the way and brought them over." I asked lightly, "The office isn't on the way to the hotel." He frowned. "She's just a young woman, and she was carrying all these documents. It would have been inconvenient for her to take a cab.

What is wrong with me giving her a ride?" Lily stood to the side, and her eyes suddenly turned red. "Ms. Pierce, please don't blame Mr. Cole. I was worried there might be an issue with the documents, so I wanted to deliver them myself." 1 23 R ||| O < Chapter 1 Before I could speak, Ethan's face darkened. Ethan sat beside me, and his phone kept lighting up. I glanced at it. The contact name was Lily. She was clearly sitting right across from him, yet she was still texting him. Ethan lowered his head to reply, and the corners of his mouth even lifted slightly. The whole thing felt absurd. After we left the hotel, Ethan said he had work to handle and told me to go home by myself. I didn't argue. After I got home, I opened Lily's private alt account on my phone. As expected, she had just posted an update: I made his girlfriend unhappy again today, but he still drove me home first.

The attached photo showed the night view outside a car window. In the corner, Ethan's hand rested on the steering wheel. I gripped my phone as my fingertips slowly went cold. chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 2 +25 Poin stared at that reply for a long time. Then I threw my phone aside, bent over, and dry-heaved. Nothing came up. I just felt sick. At 11:00 p.m., Ethan came home. When he came in, he brought in an unfamiliar sweet scent. It was Lily's perfume. I sat on the sofa and asked him, "Did driving her home take that long?" His hand paused while he was changing shoes. After a long moment, he forced out, "Traffic." I laughed. "For three hours?" He looked up at me with impatience in his eyes. "Hannah, what exactly do you want? You're the one who keeps saying Lily is sensible.

Now I drive her home, and you're unhappy about that too? We are about to get engaged. You're putting so much pressure on me!" He was the one who had cheated, but now he was blaming me for pressuring him. He really knew how to twist right and wrong. I said nothing else. He tugged at his tie. "I've nothing to say to you. I'm going to bed." Then he went straight into the bedroom. I watched him walk away, expressionless. Then I picked up my phone and sent one message each to the wedding planning company and the hotel manager. Hannah: Keep the engagement party schedule as planned.

Hannah: I want to replace the opening video. On the day of the engagement party, Lily arrived very early. She wore a white dress. It wasn't an ordinary white dress. The dress was satin, cinched at the waist, and fell to her calves. At first glance, it looked like a toned-down evening gown. She stood beside the guest check-in table and greeted guests on my behalf. Anyone who didn't know better might have thought she was one of the guests of honor. My mother saw her and frowned. "Is that your assistant?" 00 1 O < 113 Chapter 2 I nodded. +25 POVIN ོ་ད། My mother lowered her voice.

"Dressed like that at an engagement party? She has no sense of propriety." Lily seemed to hear it. Her eyes reddened again. Ethan happened to walk over. "What happened?" Lily shook her head. "Nothing. I may have worn the wrong thing and embarrassed Ms/ Pierce." Ethan looked at my mother. His tone was still restrained, but he was clearly defending Lily. "Mrs Pierce, Lily is here to help today. She has been running around all morning and working hard." My mother's face darkened. "Did I say anything?" Ethan stiffened. I gently held my mother's hand. "Mom, there are a lot of guests today.

Don't get upset over someone irrelevant." Lily's face went pale. Ethan frowned at me. "Hannah." l'ignored him. I looked beautiful. I wore a red satin gown, with a pair of pearl earrings, and my hair was pinned up. The makeup artist said I didn't look like a woman about to get engaged. I looked as if I was walking into a battle I had already won. When I looked at myself in the mirror, I felt the same way. Today wasn't really my engagement party with Ethan. It was the judgment day I had prepared for him myself. Ethan and I had known each other for seven years and had been together for five.

From our rented apartment to the home we planned to share, from having nothing to watching both sets of parents sit down to discuss wedding dates, everyone said we were the most stable couple they knew. On the night he proposed, he stood in the rain holding a bouquet of ice-blue roses. His eyes were red as he said, "Hannah Pierce, I finally have the confidence to marry you." Back then, I truly believed him. Only later did I learn that sincerity could expire too. chapters.title: Chapter 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 3 Chapter 3 ly's parents came because I had specially asked the admin department to invite them. The reason sounded perfectly reasonable. ᄊ +25 Pors Lily had been with the company for six months, had worked hard, and had come to help today. wanted to thank her in front of our families. When her parents heard they could attend an event at such an upscale hotel, they were delighted. The moment Lily's mother entered, she grabbed Lily and said, quietly but with obvious pride, "Your boss is really rich. A table here must cost a fortune, right?" Lily's father also looked around.

"Lily, you had better work hard for Ms. Pierce. Even a little of what she gives you would be enough for our family to live on for years." Lily's face turned pale. Before the party began, I left two comments on Lily's private alt account. H: [Once he gets engaged, it will be too late to change anything, and he will never want you again.] H: [If he really sees you as his girlfriend, why is he still making you sit in the audience today?] Sure enough, the moment Lily read them, the look in her eyes changed. Right after that, Ethan's phone lit up. He glanced at it and frowned as he walked out.

I stood behind him and asked, "Where are you going?" His body stiffened. "A company call." I reminded him, "The ceremony is about to start." He lowered his voice impatiently. "I know. I'm just taking a call. Can you stop being so tense?" Then he walked away quickly. Less than 30 seconds later, Lily also slipped out through the side door. I watched them leave one after the other, and instead of feeling anxious, I felt relieved. I turned my phone over in my palm and waited quietly. There was a private lounge on the hotel's third floor. It was my dressing room for the day.

Inside was a tablet connected to the main screen in the ballroom. The camera faced the door and the sofa. Originally, the wedding planning company was supposed to use it to play the video montage of my 001 < 13 Chapter 3 relationship with Ethan. Now, it was exactly what I needed. 250 Five minutes before the ceremony began, the emcee was already on stage. Music started. The lights dimmed. Every guest in the room was waiting for the couple to enter. But Ethan was gone, and so was Lily. The wedding coordinator broke into a sweat. He covered his earpiece and kept asking, "Where is Ethan's father?

Is Ethan's father still not in position?" The smile on Ethan's mother's face froze. Ethan's father frowned as well. In front of everyone, I called Ethan. It went unanswered. Whispers gradually spread through the room. I lowered my eyes. Ethan's parents looked deeply embarrassed. Ethan's mother forced a smile and tried to comfort me. "Hannah, don't worry. Ethan may be dealing with something. He will come over once he's done." Ethan's father pretended to be angry. "Just wait until I teach that brat a lesson.

He has no sense of time at all." On the other side, Lily's parents were muttering in confusion too. "How strange. Where did Lily run off to? She was here just now." "Forget about her. We need to praise Ms. Pierce later. Maybe we can get a generous bonus." I glanced at them and said nothing. The emcee walked over to me with a stiff smile. "Ms. Pierce, if we keep delaying, the opening music will end." I looked at Ethan's parents and forced a helpless expression. "Then play the video first." The big screen suddenly went black. Everyone assumed they were about to watch our relationship montage.

But when the screen lit up, the image showed the private lounge on the third floor. Lily clung to Ethan, red-eyed, her face buried against his chest. She sobbed, "Are you really getting engaged to her today? I already gave myself to you. What am I supposed to do now?" :::00 ดวอริ ||| O < 23 Amelie
